integrity: The proof is analytical. The standalone numerical checker is supplementary and not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to matched flat rectangular Möbius bands and cylinders, normalized area-uniform independent endpoints, and intrinsic geodesic distances. No arbitrary Riemannian or extrinsic-distance comparison is asserted. Historical priority remains subject to independent verification.
title: A sharp stochastic-distance ordering between flat Möbius bands and cylinders
